What we do

Civil engineering consultancy.
Based in Kolkata.

Established in 2022, Colosseum Engineering supports infrastructure agencies with technical planning and documentation.

Our work spans rural roads, bridges, railway studies, public buildings and related infrastructure across West Bengal and Tripura.
